notes: Fighting Force (USA), original release (Redump 1867). Facts only; no game bytes.
The boot EXE SLUS_004.33 chain-loads GAME.EXE with BIOS A0h:51h LoadExec at 0x800111A4; GAME.EXE is the game (menus, levels).
GAME.EXE is a self-describing PS-X EXE: load 0x80010000, entry 0x8006CD64, text 0xB1000. LoadExec places it from its header and jumps to the header entry.

generic_exclude_files.reason: Owned by the fixed_address_extents image below, which names only its code. As a generic PS-X EXE it is split at the boot EXE's text end (0x800B5000) into a code recipe plus a data-only recipe [0x800B5000,0x800C1000) that has no native entries and fails the static audit.

extents.reason: GAME.EXE code [0x80010000,0x8007A0CC): PS-X header load address 0x80010000 (LoadExec places the body there). The last jr ra is at 0x8007A0C4 (delay slot 0x8007A0C8); 0x8007A0CC starts a table of code pointers, then data tables and zero fill up to the header's text end 0x800C1000 (0 jr ra there).
